It is noteworthy that PFPN is helpful to improve the safety of the LMBs especially in the ether-based electrolyte. The electrolyte ignition tests given the self-extinguishing time (SET) was 0 s g−1 and 144 s g−1 (Figure 2g, h) for E-PFPN and E-DFOB/FEC, respectively, which prove the effectiveness of the PFPN in fire resistance. From the theoretical and experimental evidence above, we could assert that the steric effect of PFPN in Li+ solvation can weaken the solvation ability of other solvents and increase the ratio of anions in Li+ solvation. 2.2.
